newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease, seen attacking upside.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease, seen attacking upside.

text.p: Austrian shares ended little changed after a volatile session on Tuesday and traders said they expected the index to advance tomorrow.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips edged 1.18 points or 0.10 percent lower to 1,180.98. Among its constituents eight shares rose, 12 fell and one was unchanged.
"I reckon everything will pick up tomorrow and then we will go back up to 1,200," said one trader.
Another said he did not expect any major breakthroughs but saw the index testing 1,190 points over the next few days.
"The market is still well-supported at 1,180," said one trader.
The session's top gainer was Austrian microchip maker AMS, climbing 1.92 percent to 1,010 schillings.
The leading decliner was papermaker Leykam, falling 2.0 percent to 294 schillings.
The February ATX future gained 0.5 points to 1,184.5.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index shed 0.56 points or 0.13 percent to 441.46.
